verdict.rationale: YYLO is a command-line orchestrator installed from npm and run on the user's own machine. Its state lives locally: task worktrees, Git-native Ledger records, and bounded local views with no mutation API. A public GitHub repository is also present. Nothing in the pack shows a dependency on a vendor-hosted service, so the core product runs under the user's control. Missing for 10: an explicit self-hosting or offline-operation statement, open-source license evidence, and independent hands-on corroboration of fully local operation.
